name: Bloodscalp Clan Heads
label: Quest
description: Following the sorting of trophies gathered in the jungle, Nimboya confirms that the missing young troll Yenniku was not among them. To discover the truth…

clips.title: The story
paras: Following the sorting of trophies gathered in the jungle, Nimboya confirms that the missing young troll Yenniku was not among them. To discover the truth of Yenniku's fate, the Darkspear seek to compel answers from the leaders of the rival Bloodscalp tribe.

After the earlier hunt proved Yenniku was not among the fallen Bloodscalp trophies, Nimboya looks to higher leadership for answers. The Bloodscalp chief, Gan'zulah, and his witch doctor, Nezzliok the Dire, are enemies of the Darkspear tribe and would never talk willingly. Nimboya means to force the truth from their dead lips, bringing their heads to the cauldron at Grom'gol Base Camp to make them talk.

Both Bloodscalp leaders dwell deep within the ruins of Zul'Kunda in northwestern Stranglethorn Vale. Claiming their heads and casting them into the boiling brew is how Nimboya means to make them talk about Yenniku.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Yenniku was not among the heads, and I thank the Great Serpent for it. But we are no closer to finding him.

We must know the truth, and I fear that only the Bloodscalp chief and his witchdoctor know it. They are the enemies of the Darkspear tribe and will not speak freely, so we must force the truth from their dead lips!
Bring me the heads of Gan'zulah and Nezzliok the Dire and place them within this cauldron.
They are deep within Zul'Kunda. Bring their heads...we will then make them talk.

clips.title: Progress
paras: The greenish broth within the cauldron bubbles.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You place the heads of Gan'zulah and Nezzliok within the cauldron...
